attributes.action: Support Muhyadin Shardi's petition for increase timing in local libraries!
attributes.additional_details: We must gather attention to local libraries by boosting someone's confindence or courage. We must provide free, trusted access to valuable information across local libraries aroung the UK. Anyone is allowed or has the right to visit or to enter the library and must have equal timing towards across all or most local libraries. Thank you for reading this valuable, persuasive information for all trusts!!
attributes.background: Timing for local libraries must increase or most libraries will end up closing down. We must raise global awareness for local libraries to gather significant support for people with disablilities or well-beings.

rejection.details:
Opening hours for local libraries are a matter for local councils to decide, not the Government or Parliament.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
